_source: DOMINION tutorial and opening, built from plans/evil-mode-rework/tutorial-mockups (Kice 2026-11-21: build it nearly exactly). Pages a1-e9. Text is data. The helper is Rotom (written ahead, no Rotom spend).

help.title: NEW RUN
help.rotom: Rotom: “New in the business? Don't worry. Everyone starts with a leaky roof.”

options.label: Show me the ropes
options.line: Fifteen short lessons across your first week. Rotom points, you press.

options.label: Just give me tips
options.line: One line the first time each screen opens. Nothing blocks you.

options.label: I know what I'm doing
options.line: No help. You can turn tips on later in Settings.

help.foot: Change it any time: Boss Menu › Settings › Dominion › Tutorial. Replay any lesson from the Boss Menu.
help.titleTip: First Dominion? I'll walk you through it. Press Enter on New run.

lines: Every Team you've heard of started somewhere small.
Team Rocket started in a basement in Celadon.
Nobody in Kanto has heard of you.

paper.name: The Kanto Ledger
paper.head: ROCKET TIGHTENS GRIP ON CELADON
paper.body: Police say Giovanni's people now run every game corner west of the river. "Nobody else would dare," says one shopkeeper. Below the fold: a warehouse in Pewter has finally found a tenant.

lines: One thousand Pokédollars. A key. A lease on a building nobody else wanted.
It's not much. Every empire is not much, at first.

reward.head: YOU GOT
reward.note: Next: pick your Boss, your two Team Types and your first member.

kit.head: STARTING KIT
kit.note: Rook: “Is the crowbar for me? ...It's for you. OK.”

setup.boss: This is you. You fight your own battles, with any Pokémon. Your crew has rules. You'll see.
setup.types: Pick two. Every Grunt's Pokémon needs one of them. Dragon and Fairy are too proud for a uniform.
setup.typesOne: One more! Two types means more Pokémon your crew can use.
setup.member: First run? Take Rook. Cheap and loyal. An Admin costs double and might walk out.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.text: Bzzt! Welcome to Dominion, Boss. You run a crew from nothing. Each day you give orders, the city reacts, and slowly it all becomes yours. I'll show you one thing at a time.
welcome.foot: stop tips any time · Boss Menu › Replay a lesson

list: The day and its phase. Four phases: Morning, Day, Evening, Night.
Funds. Rent and wages come out every 7 days.
Heat. How hard the police are looking. Keep it low.
The region. One at a time.

steps.text: These are your first orders. In the evening you plan; tomorrow, you do. Press Enter to plan one. You get 3 actions a day.
Nice. Secure the warehouse costs ₽40. Every order shows its cost before you commit. Plan it or leave it, your call.
Two easy goals for your first week. Each pays ₽100. After 7 days they're gone, and nobody holds your hand again.
{name} is your crew. You do orders; crew do tasks. {name} is POOR at everything, so start simple: press 3 for the Roster and give a task.
The big number is the chance it works. Guard is safe. Better crew, harder tasks, bigger money.
Every night: rest or work. Skip rest three nights in a row and you're exhausted. Tonight, rest.
Every morning I tell you what happened overnight. Read it, then press Enter.
Normal isn't one of your types, so {name} can't use it. It waits in the Reserve. The Boss can use anything.

inline: Who gets hurt, who might see.

steps.text: Heat is how hard the police are looking. Jobs raise it; quiet days lower it (−3 a day). Lay Low cools it fast.
This is Kanto. Your warehouse is in {home}. Pick a district and press Enter to see its jobs. Red rings mean Rocket.
Hold Q anywhere. Point at a page, let go, you're there. Faster than the tabs.
Esc opens this from anywhere. Settings and Replay a lesson live here, so you can turn tips off or watch one again.
Every 7 days: rent and wages. Can't pay? Someone goes unpaid, and they remember.
That's Team Rocket. They own this region, and now they know your name. R opens the Rival File.
A name for the door. Type one, or pick a suggestion.
These go on every armband. Watch your crew's band change.
A mark for the door, a motto for the speeches.
Your Goal is what you want. It shapes Debates and how you can win.

lines: Then {name} dropped a Poké Ball, and a Rattata ran into it. It's yours now.
rattata.head: NEW POKÉMON

bills.head: WEEK 1 BILLS
lines: {name} counts the money twice. “We're still rich, right, Boss?”

rival.label: RIVAL NOTE · TEAM ROCKET
lines: “A new crew in Pewter. One Grunt and a leaking roof.”
“Keep an eye on them. Small things grow.”
rival.after: After the text: Rotom, lesson 14 · R Rival File

week.title: WEEK 1
week.head: THE WEEK
week.tip: That's week one. A few more lessons show up when they matter. After the Founding, you're on your own.

lines: The town says your name now, quietly.
Time for the Founding: a name, colours, a mark and a motto.

done.text: That's everything I had, Boss. The rest you learn by doing. Esc › Replay a lesson if you forget. Now go make {team} a problem.
